so.title: Google oo soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo chip-ka AI ah si ay ula tartanto Nvidia
so.summary: Shirkadda Google, oo ka tirsan kooxda Alphabet, ayaa soo bandhigtay laba nooc oo cusub oo ah chip-yada sirdoonka macmalka ah ee loo yaqaan TPU (tensor processing units), iyadoo ballaarinaysa tartankeeda ay kula jirto Nvidia, sida uu wariyay Sweden Herald.
so.imageAlt: Chip-ka Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 ee Google

en.title: Google unveils two new AI chips to compete with Nvidia
en.summary: Google, part of the Alphabet group, has unveiled two new versions of its artificial intelligence chips known as TPUs (tensor processing units), expanding its competition with Nvidia, Sweden Herald reported.

ar.title: غوغل تكشف عن شريحتين جديدتين للذكاء الاصطناعي لمنافسة إنفيديا
ar.summary: كشفت شركة غوغل، التابعة لمجموعة ألفابت، عن نسختين جديدتين من شرائح الذكاء الاصطناعي المعروفة باسم TPU (وحدات معالجة الموترات)، موسعة منافستها مع إنفيديا، بحسب سويدن هيرالد.
ar.imageAlt: شريحة وحدة معالجة الموترات 3.0 من غوغل

fr.title: Google dévoile deux nouvelles puces d'IA pour concurrencer Nvidia
fr.summary: Google, filiale du groupe Alphabet, a dévoilé deux nouvelles versions de ses puces d'intelligence artificielle appelées TPU (tensor processing units), renforçant sa concurrence avec Nvidia, rapporte Sweden Herald.
fr.imageAlt: La puce Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 de Google

nl.title: Google onthult twee nieuwe AI-chips om met Nvidia te concurreren
nl.summary: Google, onderdeel van het Alphabet-concern, heeft twee nieuwe versies onthuld van zijn chips voor kunstmatige intelligentie, bekend als TPU's (tensor processing units), en voert zo de concurrentie met Nvidia op, meldt Sweden Herald.
nl.imageAlt: De Tensor Processing Unit 3.0-chip van Google

it.title: Google presenta due nuovi chip per l'IA per sfidare Nvidia
it.summary: Google, parte del gruppo Alphabet, ha presentato due nuove versioni dei suoi chip di intelligenza artificiale noti come TPU (tensor processing units), ampliando la sfida a Nvidia, riferisce Sweden Herald.
it.imageAlt: Il chip Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 di Google

tr.title: Google, Nvidia ile rekabet için iki yeni yapay zeka çipi tanıttı
tr.summary: Alphabet grubunun parçası olan Google, TPU (tensor processing units) olarak bilinen yapay zeka çiplerinin iki yeni sürümünü tanıtarak Nvidia ile rekabetini genişletti, Sweden Herald bildirdi.

de.title: Google stellt zwei neue KI-Chips vor und fordert Nvidia heraus
de.summary: Google, Teil des Alphabet-Konzerns, hat zwei neue Versionen seiner KI-Chips, der sogenannten TPUs (Tensor Processing Units), vorgestellt und verschärft damit den Wettbewerb mit Nvidia, berichtet Sweden Herald.

es.title: Google presenta dos nuevos chips de IA para competir con Nvidia
es.summary: Google, parte del grupo Alphabet, presentó dos nuevas versiones de sus chips de inteligencia artificial conocidos como TPU (tensor processing units), ampliando su competencia con Nvidia, informó Sweden Herald.
es.imageAlt: El chip Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 de Google
